title: Evaluating Machine Translation Datasets for Low-Web Data Languages: A Gendered Lens

bias_targets.methodology: Topic modeling to identify themes associated with gender-specific keywords, morphological analysis to calculate the grammatical gender distribution of verbs, Named Entity Recognition (NER) to quantify the proportion of male versus female person names, and Masked Language Modeling (MLM) to test for contextual and stereotypical associations with occupations and adjectives.
